editionLabel: Arcane Wonders English rulebook, base game
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently dived in the sea is first in turn order.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise from the first player. If using King cards in basic mode, give King 1 to the first player, King 2 to the second player, and so on.

sources.title: Aquatica — Arcane Wonders English base-game rulebook
sources.location: Player Setup, step 3; How to Play: Player Turns

internalEvidence: Rendered publisher page 7 gives the sea-diving criterion and explains King-card numbering for basic mode. Page 12 confirms clockwise turns. This is the base game, not the Coral Reefs expansion. Source SHA-256: 06b8328dcdf4f2f2cf002f1f06f152b59ca6ecd1f69501fb74f7512acc51daf9. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not specify a tie-break for equally recent dives.
